description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's filesystem monitoring capabilities, specifically testing the integration of fsmonitor extension with various Git commands and configurations. It defines setup functions, test scenarios, and validation steps for fsmonitor behavior and interactions with the Git index and repository state.

methods.name: clean_repo
methods.description: Resets the Git repository to a clean state by performing a hard reset and cleaning untracked files.

methods.name: dirty_repo
methods.description: Modifies the repository by creating untracked, modified, and new files in various directories to simulate a dirty state.

methods.name: write_integration_script
methods.description: Sets up a Git hook script used for testing fsmonitor integration, writing tokens and file entries.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting a command to fail.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to be executed after the test case.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisites before running certain tests.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new repository environment for testing.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks for specific patterns in command output during tests.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Verifies that a specified path is a file.

methods.name: test_might_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it might fail; not halting the test if it does.

methods.name: test_region
methods.description: Checks a specific region in a trace or output file for expected content.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of a test sequence.

methods.name: check_sparse_index_behavior
methods.description: Verifies the behavior of the sparse index with respect to detectability and index ensuring during status operations.
